scripts.build: rm -rf dist && cp -R public dist && bun build src/main.ts --outdir dist --entry-naming graffiti.[ext] --target browser --minify --sourcemap=linked
scripts.test: start-server-and-test 'bun run start' http://localhost:4002 'bun run test:served'
scripts.test:served: bun test test/website.test.ts && wdio run wdio.conf.ts
